subject: plotting a histogram under time scaled tree

messages.author: 54618fd6a8245454
messages.subject: plotting a histogram under time scaled tree
parts:
Hi,

I recently discovered this package and it is amazing!!! I have a question about lining up x axis scales. I have a time scaled tree and a histogram with matching data. I'm using "grid" and "cowplot" to line up both plots vertically and I've set the xaxis of both plots using scale_x_ggtree() for the tree and scale_x_continuous() for the histogram. However no matter how I set the breaks and labels I can't seem to get them to line up. Any thoughts on how I might be able to do this? Thanks again for all of your work on this package!!!

Nick

messages.author: 54618fd6a8245454
messages.subject: Re: plotting a histogram under time scaled tree
parts: I think I figured out the issue. You need to set the xlim_tree() to lager than the plot area otherwise it seems to mess with the scale to fit the tree.
